EFG Bank European Financial Group holds the banking stake, while Consolidated Lamda Holdings carries the family's property-development interest. No single family member has sole control of Lamda, reflecting collective ownership across the portfolio her father built in shipping, finance, refining, construction and property.

uncertainties.detail: The source record uses Margarita Latsis; Forbes uses Margarita Latsis Catsiapis, while the official foundation and Greek reporting continue to use Margarita Latsis or Latsi. The consistent father, siblings, nationality and holdings establish one person. No name correction is proposed because the shorter family-name form is also current and official.

Marianna is Margarita's sister and a separate investor. The 2019-2020 reorganisation removed Marianna's branch from Lamda Development while the families of Spiro and Margarita retained their CLH interests. Marianna's shipping and later investment activities are not attributed to Margarita.

Forbes attributes investment stakes to Margarita and her family, but corporate disclosures place the major EFG, Lamda and HELLENiQ interests behind family-controlled holding companies. Their company assets, revenues and projects are not treated as Margarita's sole personal property, and no individual Lamda family member is disclosed as having sole control.

Margarita is a supervisory-board member of the John S. Latsis Public Benefit Foundation. Foundation property and programmes belong to the separate non-profit institution and are not classified as her personal wealth.

A secondary wealth-data site gives 3 June 1961, but no strong primary or established business source located confirms the exact date. Forbes publishes a current age only. Birth day, month and year therefore remain unproposed.
No personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website met the verification threshold. Exact-name searches mainly returned unrelated people, family-company material or the Forbes profile.

Politics, controversies, allegations, legal matters, sanctions, private-family trivia beyond essential lineage and holdings allocation, detailed philanthropy, vessel research, net-worth figures and rankings were excluded.
